Command `python3 -c "
# BAM format:
# 1. Magic: BAM\\x01 (4 bytes)
# 2. Header text length (int32)
# 3. Header text
# 4. n_ref (int32)
# For each ref: ref_name_len (int32), ref_name, ref_len (int32)
# 5. For each alignment:
#    - block_size (int32)
#    - refID (int32)
#    - pos (int32)
#    - bin_mq_nl (int32): bin(16) | mapQ(8) | l_read_name(8)
#    - flag_nc (int32): flag(16) | n_cigar(16)
#    - l_seq (int32)
#    - next_refID (int32)
#    - next_pos (int32)
#    - tlen (int32)
#    - read_name (l_read_name bytes, padded to 4)
#    - cigar (n_cigar * 4 bytes)
#    - seq (l_seq bytes, half-byte packed)
#    - qual (l_seq bytes)
#    - aux data
print('BAM format understood')
"` executed with exit code 0.
